officialSeasonProductPage.title: Arbor Snowboarding - A-Frame Snowboard 24/25
officialSeasonProductPage.evidence: Official page explicitly identifies 24/25. Confirms Directional, Men's, System Camber/Parabolic Camber, Grip Tech and 3D Fender. Product copy says large-radius sidecut and carbon inlay stringers target powder/control while remaining a capable daily driver. Lists official construction: Real Wood Powerply, Grip Tech 2.25 mm, Fender 3 degrees, RWD Carbon A-Frames, 0.9 cm taper, Highland III Core, Sintered Base, Mixed Glassing, 2x4 14-Pack inserts, wrapped sidewalls and recycled steel edges. Table lists five sizes and the full geometry captured below.

sameSeasonRideTest.title: Review: Arbor A-Frame Snowboard
sameSeasonRideTest.sampleYearDisclosure: Article is season-labelled 2024-25 and tests the 162; exact factory production-year marking is not disclosed.

observations.powder: 5/5; reviewer says broad nose floats easily and board is excellent in deep powder.
observations.groomers: 2/5; reviewer reports squirrely feel at moderate speed and low confidence at high speed, attributing this to the short effective edge/contact-point placement and sidecut.
observations.crud: 4/5; stiff tail and broad nose help in tracked snow.
observations.jumping: 3/5; not a freestyle board, feels light and can be loaded for pop after adapting to the stiff tail.
observations.overall: 4/5; reviewer recommends to intermediate/advanced all-mountain riders or experts wanting a powder-focused board, but not riders prioritizing high-speed groomer carving.

sameSeasonRideTest.limitations: One rider/sample, no number of test days or exact daily conditions disclosed; use as directional evidence, not a universally representative measurement.

historicalReviewNotSameSeason.evidence: Page updated 2025-09-01 but its disclosed physical sample is Arbor A-Frame 2023, 158 cm, ridden 2022-03-24. It had no fresh snow during that test. Historical model context only; not treated as 2024-25 sample evidence. Its measured 2880 g weight is also not transferred to the 2025 size 162.

officialUsPricing.priceType: official US storefront listed regular/compare-at price and dynamic sale price
officialUsPricing.note: Dynamic US regional offer; neither price confirms Chinese-market pricing and neither replaces the seed's CNY value.

scoreReview.decision: Lower stability and response because the same-season 162 review gives groomers 2/5 and reports instability already at moderate speed and low high-speed confidence; retain credit for 4/5 tracked-snow performance. Raise float because the same test gives powder 5/5 and describes strong flotation in deep snow. These are qualitative editorial judgments informed by the test; no external numeric rating is converted linearly. Park and forgiveness are retained: the board is not a freestyle design, the reviewer gives jumping 3/5, and the stiff full-camber tail is not especially forgiving. Value remains low-confidence because the CNY 6599 seed price has no verified China-market source.
scoreReview.confidence: low; one same-season-labelled 162 test with production year and daily test conditions not fully disclosed
